summary: Retest of iteration 8 (dynamic equipment). Verified fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/storage.js clearAllData() now removes 'homeshred:equipment'. Reset flow correctly restores exactly the 6 default equipment rows and clears LS key. No regressions in add/remove equipment flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset flow now clears equipment key. Verified via Playwright: 8 rows (6 defaults + Dumbbells + Sandbag custom) -> Reset -> 6 default rows exactly, localStorage['homeshred:equipment']=null. Add/remove equipment still updates Today (NEW badges observed) and removed items disappear from Settings list. Modal must be closed via [data-testid=add-equipment-close] before clicking reset (Escape does not close it).
rca of the issue: Prior bug: clearAllData() only removed sessions/settings keys, so equipment additions persisted after reset. Fix: added localStorage.removeItem('homeshred:equipment'). loadEquipment() falls back to DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT_IDS when key absent, producing the correct 6 defaults post-reset.
